evidence.title: 畅和堂
evidence.locator: v4 p.325, under 畅和堂; source ref 5-338
evidence.excerpt_zh: 人和庶绩熙，政协天心畅。德化惭未敷，顽民競罔上。邪慝煽妖言，悖逆兼谬妄。竭力肃官箴，旋转俟昊贶。自古图治之要，首在人和。虞书言，庶尹允谐，九功惟叙，亦归之于和而已。天以春生万物，其德在和，故能群生咸畅。人君以人法天，亦当使上下休和，则民气恬熙，而眚沴自消，邪慝何由而作。去岁，禁城忽有教匪构乱之事。固由顽民不逞，妄煽妖言。无知乡愚，甘蹈刑辟。然我君臣，平日敷宣德化，尚有未至，因致此意外之警。幸邪氛以次殄除。新岁，人心渐觉安定，连得瑞雪，遍被春田。可知以和召和，乃天地自然之理。旋转之柄，实在人为。予惟有刻思自励，董正百官，不敢谓昊贶优隆，稍弛敬修之愿。偶陟斯堂，用抒予胸臆
evidence.summary: Poem 畅和堂 by the Jiaqing Emperor, 1814, filed by the editors under 畅和堂.

evidence.title: 畅和堂
evidence.locator: v4 p.326, under 畅和堂; source ref 5-347
evidence.excerpt_zh: 惠风扬暖律，气畅景舒和。碧染临池柳，青敷绿砌莎。高堂御园敞，佳日闰春多。冲澹天怀永，卷阿叶有那。
evidence.summary: Poem 畅和堂 by the Jiaqing Emperor, 1814, filed by the editors under 畅和堂.

evidence.title: 畅和堂
evidence.locator: v4 p.326, under 畅和堂; source ref 5-350
evidence.excerpt_zh: 临水书堂淑景延，惠风和畅暮春天。授时岂慕禊游侣，御世勤求佐治贤。事勿因循政斯布，俗偏浇薄化难宣。恐成锢疾增乾惕，静俟昊恩点转旋。
evidence.summary: Poem 畅和堂 by the Jiaqing Emperor, 1814, filed by the editors under 畅和堂.

evidence.title: 畅和堂
evidence.locator: v4 p.327, under 畅和堂; source ref 6-050
evidence.excerpt_zh: 天地絪缊物咸畅，受生感召气中和。良知有本正途守，外诱无形邪径多。利薮迷津勿干涉，礼门义路不差讹。共遵王道化浇薄，政协年康除细苛。
evidence.summary: Poem 畅和堂 by the Jiaqing Emperor, 1814, filed by the editors under 畅和堂.

evidence.title: 澄霞宇
evidence.locator: v4 p.325, under 畅和堂; source ref 5-328
evidence.excerpt_zh: 初韶春骀荡，西岭灿明霞。澄洁虚岚表，斒斓远岸涯。灯楼映遥霭，蓂砌吐新华。玉镜冰床碾，水关径不賖。
evidence.summary: Poem 澄霞宇 by the Jiaqing Emperor, 1814, filed by the editors under 畅和堂.

evidence.title: 澄霞宇
evidence.locator: v4 p.325, under 畅和堂; source ref 5-339
evidence.excerpt_zh: 水绕汀洲两岸斜，依依新柳织晴霞。趁闲偶放兰舟过，仍盼春膏布迩遐。任重仔肩凛克承，去邪以正用才能。德凉难使民从化，何日方欣宇宙澄。
evidence.summary: Poem 澄霞宇 by the Jiaqing Emperor, 1814, filed by the editors under 畅和堂.

evidence.title: 澄霞宇
evidence.locator: v4 p.326, under 畅和堂; source ref 6-040
evidence.excerpt_zh: 高宇辉秋日，天容共水长。泬寥净柳岸，澄洁滴荷塘。景咏绮春苑，神游避暑庄。舒眸望北岭，霞影远林扬。
evidence.summary: Poem 澄霞宇 by the Jiaqing Emperor, 1814, filed by the editors under 畅和堂.

evidence.title: 澄霞宇
evidence.locator: v4 p.327, under 畅和堂; source ref 6-051
evidence.excerpt_zh: 堤畔窗临敞，阶凭溪水涯。林中缀红叶，簾下绚黄花。暖爱南轩旭，辉腾西岭霞。澄心治寰宇，以四海为家。
evidence.summary: Poem 澄霞宇 by the Jiaqing Emperor, 1814, filed by the editors under 畅和堂.

evidence.title: 澄霞宇听泉
evidence.locator: v4 p.328, under 畅和堂; source ref 6-092
evidence.excerpt_zh: 西窗对长堤，韶光满绿野。引来墙外泉，伏流土堰下。东溪地势低，溅石清波泻。天然韵琮琤，元音自淡雅。
evidence.summary: Poem 澄霞宇听泉 by the Jiaqing Emperor, 1815, filed by the editors under 畅和堂.

evidence.title: 题畅和堂
evidence.locator: v4 p.324, under 畅和堂; source ref 5-327
evidence.excerpt_zh: 神祠专建祝淮河，堂构墙阴近曲阿。永靖波澜朝海顺，畅调风雨愿时和。心殷民物三江盛，志辑修防百卷多。一日万几此最要，馆臣敬事慎毋讹。东南腴壤相接，民物殷阗，淮扬尤称繁阜。惟濒夹河淮，长川巨浸，时虞泛溢。国家不惜数千百万帑金，为之堤防疏浚。且念虑时萦，形诸宵旰。年前，曾命馆臣修辑《治河方略》，屡经申谕诸臣，务期详慎赅备。以此乃经国之书，用垂久远，非缀辑辞章可比。兹堂正当新建河神祠之后，升香小憩，因述予缱绻之思焉。
evidence.summary: Poem 题畅和堂 by the Jiaqing Emperor, 1814, filed by the editors under 畅和堂.

evidence.title: Site status table, about 2011: nothing visible, or built over
evidence.summary: Same table. In it the first group shows no visible remains; 得全阁, 流香渚, 凤麟洲, 涵秋馆, 蔚藻堂, 中和堂, 敷春堂 and 心镜轩 have service buildings on them, and 含晖楼, 澄心堂, 延寿寺, 清夏堂 and 喜雨山房 are occupied by other institutions. 澹泊宁静 and several others have been dug since, so this is out of date for them.

evidence.title: 张宝章: Qichun Yuan under Jiaqing and Daoguang
evidence.summary: Axis from the great gate in the south-east: 勤政殿, 中和堂, 敷春堂, up to 问月楼 on the lake shore. In the north a large water split by a causeway, with 凤麟洲 on an island in the east part; south of the small western lake 展诗应律, 庄严法界, 生冬室, 春泽斋, 四宜书屋. On two southern islands 畅和堂 and 绿满轩, with 澄心堂 between 畅和堂 and 正觉寺. This also gives QC09 庄严法界 a rough position (Q11).

evidence.title: 圆明园五朝御制诗文集注 v4, editors' note on 绮春园
evidence.summary: Formed from princes' and ministers' gardens, about 54.3 ha. Taken back from Fuheng's heirs and renamed in 1769; gate, tiger-stone wall and 正觉寺 added by 1773, rebuilt in 1795. Jiaqing's growth came in three stages: the western and central groups of the Thirty Scenes first, then the new gate and eastern scenes, finally the south-west (招凉榭, 湛清轩, 畅和堂, 澄心堂, the shrines), gathered as a New Twenty Scenes.

evidence.title: 圆明园五朝御制诗文集注 v4, editors' note on 畅和堂
evidence.summary: South-west corner, by the Hanlin garden 澄怀园: from 1732 Ertai's 晚香园, then Yin Jishan's 寻春园, derelict after 1770, rebuilt 1813. Gate 松路花龛 of three bays, main hall five bays in two rolls with side halls 澄霞宇 and 开襟馆, and a square pavilion 森翠. West of its wall is the Hanlin garden 澄怀园.

searched: No picture of it found in the Forty Scenes album, its 1745 woodcuts, the Bertin gouaches and the 1887 lithograph; the 20 Xiyang Lou plates; ruin photographs on Commons, at Östasiatiska museet, the Slovene Ethnographic Museum, Historical Photographs of China, the Rijksmuseum, Wellcome and in NDL's albums of about 1900; today's photographs on Commons.
